# Vendor scoring policy

Each questionnaire answer is scored as follows: yes counts as full credit, partial as half credit and no as none.
A blank answer earns no credit and is listed for follow-up with the vendor.

The risk score is 100 minus the weighted credit as a percentage of the total weight. Bands are set in questions.json.

Vendors rated high are reviewed by the security committee before renewal. Vendors rated medium need a remediation
plan within 60 days. Questionnaires older than 12 months are treated as expired and must be resubmitted.
